note: Testimony wall + Friday celebration rotation. Consent-gated: add only submissions approved in the Community Inbox (source lotl-testimony). First name + city only.

testimonies.name: Ama
testimonies.text: I had church at 2am nursing my baby. I cried through worship. God met me.

testimonies.name: Kwame
testimonies.text: Sent my frustration Tuesday, answer came Friday with Scriptures. I booked prayer.

testimonies.name: Blessing
testimonies.text: Express service on the bus, altar call in my seat. I gave my life again.

testimonies.name: Yaw
testimonies.text: I stopped drinking after the Word on new beginnings. My wife says I am a new man.

testimonies.name: Efua
testimonies.text: My shop was empty for weeks. I tithed with love and trusted — customers came back.

testimonies.name: Daniel
testimonies.text: Watched with my kids every Sunday. They now ask for 'church on the phone' after school.
